query: Explain the Rainmaker method for novation deals. How can I automate the Discovery, Anchor, and Delivery phases?
expected_behavior: Phase 1 Discovery: position as information gatherer, collect motivation/timeline/condition
Phase 2 Anchor: set price expectations using bracket technique and comps
Phase 3 Delivery: white glove closing, DocuSign, property updates, MLS listing
Compares novation vs wholesale: profit ($15K-$50K+ vs $5K-$15K), timeline, buyer pool
Lists AI automation opportunities for each phase
